figurative_meaning_en: Achieving success by taking a risk
example_sentences_in_bangla: এবার বিনিয়োগে বাজি মেরেছি, অনেক লাভ হলো।
জীবনে একবার বাজি মারলে সবকিছু বদলে যায়।
example_sentences_in_english: This time I took a gamble on the investment and made a huge profit.
Taking a chance in life can change everything for the better.
note: The idiom draws from traditional betting practices in Bengali society, often linked to games of chance.
